spinal_cord.volume_method: Enclosed volume of the published closed surface
spinal_cord.placement: Rigid translation onto the brainstem; no rotation or scaling
spinal_cord.division: Mirrored objects publish their two disconnected halves; no triangle is cut

segmentation_agreement.method: Dice of each NextBrain learning-unit union with the same structure's aseg label, aseg resampled onto the NextBrain grid by nearest neighbour
